releaseNotes.summary: Juno v0.4.1 Beta — Unified Agent Runtime. Bot Mode, Code Mode, Council, /btw, room/team and delegated work now share one durable task system. Unsigned installer; updates are manual.
highlights: One shared task identity and lifecycle across Bot Mode, Code Mode, Council, /btw and room/team execution.
More reliable cancellation, recovery, model-call accounting and permission state, with one terminal record per task.
Council planner/reviewer calls and room member calls are durable task calls with their own model and usage.
Stronger Code Mode model-selection boundaries: Juno verifies the exact model Boreal binds.
improvements: Warm short replies measured about 2.29–2.92 seconds on the tested route; durable task overhead about 7.06 ms p50. Measurements, not guarantees.
Ariadne remains independently evaluative; no executor can mark its own work verified.
Crash-notice behavior was qualified on the installed test identity.
The compact installer is about 271.7 MB; the full/offline installer is about 488.6 MB.
Boreal, Pi and OMP remain bounded execution components behind the Juno task system.
fixes: Cancellation now settles through the task runtime and cannot be recorded as success.
Late provider usage is recorded as late usage without rewriting the terminal receipt.
A duplicate completion or recovery replay cannot double-charge a task.
knownIssues: The Windows installer is unsigned. Windows may show Unknown Publisher or SmartScreen, and some managed PCs may block it.
Updates are manual. The signed automatic-installer upgrade path is not qualified; the feed only announces a release and opens the release page.
Live microphone recording was not exercised during final qualification; installed speech components and bundled Whisper transcription passed.
The tested browser model omitted a required tabId on its initial close call. Juno reported the error and the session was released.
A workspace-wide hard spending cap remains unenforceable across some external provider routes.
No clean-room Windows VM was used; the installed full/offline variant was tested on the owner existing Windows environment.
releaseNotes.compatibility: Windows 11 x64. Existing v0.4.0 profiles upgrade in place with this manual installer. Keep the v0.4.0 installer and a data backup for rollback; rollback rewrites schema metadata but preserves data.
